children: On August 27, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that its common stock failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) for 30 consecutive trading days. Trading continues on the Nasdaq Global Market under TCRX, and the company has 180 days until February 23, 2027, to regain compliance, with a potential additional 180-day period if it transfers to the Nasdaq Capital Market.
